description: One dataset containing Discover story records, publisher/show records with nested episodes, or episode records with snap media. Every record carries a recordType field and no empty values.

episodes.description: Dataset items with recordType=episode: one episode per input URL, with its snap list and playable HLS URL.
episodes.title: Episodes

publishers.description: Dataset items with recordType=publisher: profile, season summary, latest episodes, and optional full season history.
publishers.title: Publishers and shows

stories.description: Dataset items with recordType=discoverStory: the current Snapchat Discover feed for the selected country and locale.
stories.title: Discover stories

title: Snapchat Discover Publisher Show Extractor Output
